# mesh-mind

> N sovereign nodes, one shared shadow: the collective collapse law — no center, provenance kept, doors held, at kappa 0.618. Gated 34/34 before first use. The seam + the photonic twin, composed. MIT.

mesh-mind is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
